purpose: Fit exactly one domain-wise monotone physical-density calibration layer for a new V80 candidate using only the already consumed V72 stage-A candidate and truth. Correct the identified one-point tail/Q4 failure while preserving the inherited spatial ordering, apply the identical map to the paired control, and stop before any V79 selected input or target access.

scientific_hypothesis.diagnosed_failure: V72 solved high-k power and residual RMS but its hard within-stratum spatial rank allocation made the TNG100 physical upper tail and Q4 too large.
scientific_hypothesis.candidate_change: Add a domain-wise pooled monotone y-space quantile-calibration layer trained on consumed development candidate-versus-truth histograms, then restore each cube residual DC relative to the unchanged conditional mean.
scientific_hypothesis.spatial_property: A single monotone scalar map preserves total-field voxel ordering before the exact cube-DC correction and does not introduce a Fourier A(k), density clipping, target-conditioned inference, or a new learned spatial field.
scientific_hypothesis.paired_control: Apply the identical frozen domain map and exact DC projection to the paired independent V63 marginal control, so maximum-energy comparison isolates inherited spatial coupling rather than one-point calibration.
scientific_hypothesis.limitations: The calibration is trained on only sixteen already consumed queries per domain and may not transfer. V79 is the single target-unseen screen; no claim is made from the calibration-fit diagnostics.

frozen_calibration_algorithm.source_distribution: all 16x16 generated candidate cubes in the consumed domain ensemble, pooled with equal voxel weight
frozen_calibration_algorithm.reference_distribution: the 16 unique truth cubes in the same consumed domain ensemble, each counted exactly once
frozen_calibration_algorithm.histogram_accumulation: stream one query at a time in float64; values outside the frozen range or nonfinite values are fatal
frozen_calibration_algorithm.source_probability: mid-count empirical CDF at every occupied source bin center
frozen_calibration_algorithm.truth_inverse: linear interpolation of source probabilities against the mid-count empirical CDF at occupied truth bin centers
frozen_calibration_algorithm.interior_map: piecewise linear interpolation through occupied source-bin centers and their truth inverse-CDF values
frozen_calibration_algorithm.outside_occupied_source_support: unit-slope linear extrapolation anchored continuously at the first and last occupied source centers; no clipping
frozen_calibration_algorithm.monotonicity: mapped knots must be finite and nondecreasing; no isotonic repair or smoothing parameter is permitted
frozen_calibration_algorithm.application: apply the domain map to the complete generated y field, subtract the unchanged conditional mean, remove each residual cube mean in float64, and add the unchanged conditional mean
frozen_calibration_algorithm.candidate_and_control_map_equality: bitwise identical calibration knots and application code

training_fit_diagnostics.role: report only; never choose, reject, tune, or refit the V80 calibration
report_before_and_after: pooled histogram total variation to consumed truth
histogram-derived q99.999 y and dex error
